## Summary

The IEEE registry lists ten MA-L blocks to Barrot Technology, five as "Barrot Technology Co.,LTD" and five as "Barrot Technology Co.,Ltd.", at addresses in Haidian District, Beijing [1]. Barrot's own site gives its headquarters as Jiahua Building, 9 Shangdi Third Street, Haidian District, Beijing, sells Bluetooth chips, wireless modules, Bluetooth plus Wi-Fi modules and its BARROT Bluetooth protocol stack, names its BR8051 series of chips, and calls itself one of the world's top three commercial Bluetooth protocol stack vendors [2].

A MAC in these blocks is most likely a Bluetooth or Wi-Fi module inside someone else's product, often a car [2][4]. Barrot's own SoCs cover Bluetooth 5.2, 5.4 and 6.0 in BLE single-mode and BR/EDR plus BLE dual-mode variants, qualified to AEC-Q100/AEC-Q104 for automotive use, for smart home, industrial, vehicle, medical, wearable, audio and electronic shelf label applications [3]. Its automotive-grade modules add Wi-Fi 5, 6, 6E and 7, its stack is Bluetooth 6.0 qualified, and it supplied the LE Audio solution in the smart #5 [4]. A driver catalogue lists the Barrot BR8554 as a Bluetooth chipset [5]. The company site lists automotive uses including entertainment audio and video systems, rearview mirrors, digital keys, T-boxes and charging stations, and IoT uses including set-top boxes, Bluetooth remote controls, micro printers, label machines and wearables [2].

Parent company, founding year, FCC grantee codes, randomization and security history are not documented by the sources consulted; the FCC ID databases refused automated access from this session.
